summary: Iteration 8 frontend retest (smart-keypad summon + re-summon-on-exit). All 5 previously-listed scenarios now PASS after restarting expo to bundle the latest code. The previously failing DEEP PIN flow is fixed: tapping 'Summon room' after entering PIN posts {phrase, pin} to /api/rooms/summon (verified by intercepting the request: body = '{"phrase":"midnight harbor sky a799","pin":"4567"}'). The matching Deep room is returned and tapping the room card navigates to /room/<room_id>. Back navigation resets the home screen to idle (phrase-input no longer visible). LIGHT phrase performs phrase-only summon, keypad does NOT appear, and the Light room card is shown. Premium screen renders without red-screen and shows currency toggle + Monthly/Yearly plans. Backend pytest was NOT rerun per main-agent instruction. Note: Metro is running in CI mode (reloads disabled), so an expo restart is required for every frontend code change before testing.

react_native_issues.issue: Deprecated package still in use. /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/index.tsx:15 imports `Audio` from 'expo-av'. Migrate to expo-audio (recording) and expo-video. Console emits the deprecation warning on every screen load.

action_items: Migrate expo-av usage in /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/index.tsx to expo-audio (recording) and expo-video before SDK 54.
Optional: convert Metro CI mode → watch mode in development so frontend code changes hot-reload without an expo restart.
critical_code_review_comments: summonWithPin() correctly reads phrase + pin from state and POSTs {phrase, pin} (verified at runtime).
useFocusEffect on the Home screen resets all state on every focus — meets the re-summon-on-exit requirement.
Phrase-only summon path is unchanged for Light rooms and still does not surface the keypad.
All new interactive elements have testID (mic-orb, type-phrase-btn, phrase-input, phrase-continue-btn, summon-pin-dots, pin-key-*, summon-btn, room-card-*, leave-room-*).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Whenever you change frontend source, run `sudo supervisorctl restart expo` and wait ~10s before re-testing — Metro is started with CI=true (reloads disabled), so an in-place reload of the page will keep serving the stale bundle. To seed an authenticated session on web, set localStorage key 'consentalk.session_token' BEFORE navigating to the in-app route (the first navigation to '/' without a token redirects to '/auth' and the auth screen does not auto-redirect back even if a token appears later). Use page.goto('/') then evaluate setItem then page.goto('/') again. Reference seed script: /tmp/seed_iter9.py.
rca_of_issue: Iteration 6 reported the keypad summon POST omitted the PIN because onPress={summon} on the Button passed the React-Native GestureResponderEvent as the first positional arg, which collided with summon's skipPin default param and short-circuited the Deep flow. Main agent's fix renamed summon → summonWithPin, removed the positional arg, and reads phrase/pin directly from component state. Verified at runtime by intercepting the network request: second /api/rooms/summon body is '{"phrase":"…","pin":"4567"}'.
